_comment: b06 retake: take 1 rendered the presenter as a floating torso; prompt now demands full-body figures standing on the floor.

globalStyle.voice: @me verified avatar voice (identical pitch, tone, accent in every clip)
globalStyle.outfit: crisp white shirt and black blazer (identical in every scene)
globalStyle.background: a seamless, softly lit warm cream studio backdrop (pale warm off-white, like fine paper), perfectly plain with a very gentle soft falloff toward the edges, nothing else in the frame, identical in every scene
globalStyle.gestures: Standing still in the same spot, natural calm hand gestures kept below chest level
globalStyle.audio: @me verified avatar voice ONLY, continuous speech filling the full clip at a brisk explainer pace, NO background music, NO silence at start or end
globalStyle.negativePrompts: Avatar stays centered in the foreground with face and body fully visible at all times; NO objects, icons, graphics or props anywhere in the frame; NO text on screen, NO captions, NO name tags, NO logos, NO outfit change, NO camera cut, NO tripod, NO camera or microphone or any studio equipment visible in frame, nothing in front of the avatar
globalStyle.camera: Locked-off static shot, medium close-up framed from chest up, avatar centered in frame at the same size in every scene, eye level, 50mm lens look, no zoom, no pan, no camera movement; the camera itself is never visible
globalStyle.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage of a real human presenter recorded in one studio session, natural skin texture, natural eye contact and accurate lip sync, soft flattering key light from the front with soft fill and no harsh shadows, identical exposure and white balance in every scene
globalStyle.delivery: Warm, confident, premium brand-film narration, like a founder speaking directly to a colleague: steady brisk pace, continuous speech, no long pauses, natural emphasis on key words; speak the dialogue exactly once, word for word, never repeat, stretch or slow down a word

scenes.broll3D: A wide shot of a bright modern seminar room seen from floor to ceiling: a stylised 3D presenter figure with clean simple features, FULL BODY visible from head to shoes, standing firmly on the floor beside a large floating frosted-glass presentation board, gesturing toward it; on the board, blank slide cards with simple abstract charts and terracotta accent shapes slide in one after another and stack neatly; two stylised junior colleagues, also fully visible, sit on chairs watching; every person is complete with legs and feet on the floor, nobody is cropped or floating; walnut and cream room; warm palette of cream, ivory, soft terracotta, copper and walnut, gentle soft daylight, premium technology product commercial look, soft bloom, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
